# Essor

> **Essor** is a school-management web application operated by **Eiden Group**
> (Agadir, Morocco). It is designed for private paramedical training schools,
> institutes, and multi-campus networks. Single source of truth for the product
> and its entity relationships: https://essor.eiden-group.com
>
> Tagline: *"Zéro Excel, zéro chaos."*

## Brand entity relationships

- **Essor** → product/brand (SoftwareApplication, `#software`).
- **Eiden Group** → company / publisher / operator (Organization, `#organization`).
- **essor.eiden-group.com** → the web surface for the product (WebSite, `#website`).
- **Essor is not the company** | Eiden Group is the legal entity behind Essor.

## What Essor does (marketing-site facts, matching visible copy)

- Étudiants / enrollment: student records, enrollment by filière (Infirmier polyvalent, Prothèse dentaire, Kinésithérapie, Sage-femme…) and semester, group, and status.
- Planning: weekly timetable, session scheduling, room + trainer assignment, double-booking prevention.
- Paiements: per-student monthly installments, automatic late/unpaid flags, PDF receipts, email reminders, real-time outstanding-balance view for the director.
- Examens & bulletins: exam planning, weighted averages per module, report cards and transcripts with a decision (Admis / Rattrapage / Ajourné).
- Stages cliniques: assign students to host structures (hospitals, clinics), track capacity per service, generate + sign internship agreements (conventions).
- Rôles: separate accounts for direction, scolarité / affaires estudiantines, and formateurs.

## Who it is for

Directors of private health-training schools, student-affairs officers, and trainers.
Serves single centres or multi-campus networks. Moroccan context (filières FR/AR, MAD,
CNDP, CNSS, conventions types, stages en milieu hospitalier marocain).

## Pricing (matching the visible pricing section)

- **Essentiel** | from 1 000 MAD HT / month, single administrator.
- **Pro** | from 2 000 MAD HT / month, multi-role team: payments, bulletins, stages.
- **Réseau** | custom quote, multi-campus.
- Prices scale per 100-student tier on the same page. Annual billing = 2 months free.
- No setup or hidden fees. Onboarding, training, updates and support are included.
- Monthly plans have no lock-in; annual = optional commitment for the 2-month discount.

## Availability & location

- **Where**: Morocco (Agadir, Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tanger, Fès, Meknès,
  Oujda, and any city with a paramedical school or training centre). The product
  is web-hosted, not city-limited.
- **HQ**: Eiden Group | Agadir Bay, Technopole 1, Bloc B, Agadir 80000, Morocco.
- **Data hosting**: EU infrastructure; encrypted in transit and at rest;
  data physically isolated per school.

## Language & i18n

- Current interface language: **French only** (Moroccan French conventions for
  school terminology).
- No `/ar/` Arabic route is currently implemented and therefore **not** declared
  via `hreflang` on the site.

## Onboarding & demo facts

- Setup: no installation | runs in the browser. Importing a multi-hundred-student
  roster from Excel takes about a morning.
- Demo: 20-minute guided session on the school's own data; booked via the
  `#contact` form (or the demo CTA) on the home page.

## Privacy & data handling (matching the policy page)

- No advertising cookies or third-party trackers used other than **Amplitude**
  (product analytics) and optional transactional email providers.
- Demo requests: stored max 24 months unless converted to customer.
- Customer school data: retained for the duration of the contract, then
  returned or purged within 90 days.
- Users can exercise their rights under Moroccan CNDP and, for EU-based
  individuals, GDPR.
